# RapidLaTeXOCR canonical fixtures

These four PNG files are copied byte-for-byte from the upstream
`RapidAI/RapidLaTeXOCR` repository at commit
`21a6365738e6ae74006983ee023755f508739532`:

- `tests/test_files/1.png`
- `tests/test_files/2.png`
- `tests/test_files/5.png`
- `tests/test_files/6.png`

They are used only by the real-model regression workflow. The expected LaTeX
strings come from upstream `tests/test_main.py` at the same commit.

Upstream project license: MIT.
Upstream license source:
`https://github.com/RapidAI/RapidLaTeXOCR/blob/21a6365738e6ae74006983ee023755f508739532/LICENSE`

No model weights are stored in this repository.
